name: Pacing Control
description: Declarative preset for scene-to-summary ratio and beat spacing. Host application is not implemented.
purpose: Match narrative speed to the current dramatic job.
writing_goals: Compress travel, chores, and repeated procedure
Vary paragraph and sentence length with pressure
Announce time skips instead of smuggling them
constraints: Do not scene-play a logistics list
Do not skip a promised confrontation
checklist: High-stakes beats occupy more page than setup
Repeated actions are collapsed after the first occurrence
The chapter ends on forward motion, not idle description
